carry_forwards_added.title: D2 ingestion skip — single artifact chunk exceeded nomic-embed-text size cap
carry_forwards_added.what_surfaced: During D2 bootstrap, 52 of 53 canonical artifacts indexed successfully. 1 artifact skipped: artifacts/iterations/0.2.17/iteration-close-0.2.17.md chunk-5 (out of 6 chunks) failed embed with HTTP 400 Bad Request from Ollama /api/embed endpoint. Cause: chunk content exceeds nomic-embed-text's effective input size cap. Other 5 chunks of the same file did index successfully. Bootstrap exit code: 0; result.skipped_paths records the skip with reason.
carry_forwards_added.mechanism: aho.rag._chunk_text uses chunk_size=4000 with overlap=500. Per src/aho/rag/__init__.py docstring (line ~198-202): 'nomic-embed-text in Ollama 0.20 caps around ~7000 chars for whitespace-heavy text and ~5000 for dense JSON. We slice at 4000 with 500-char overlap so a single concept can land in adjacent chunks without breaking similarity.' The 4000-char chunks usually fit, but iteration-close-0.2.17.md chunk-5 evidently contained dense content that exceeded the embedder's tokenization budget. The bootstrap module's per-chunk try/except catches the embed failure, records the skip, and continues — design works as intended.
carry_forwards_added.disposition: Cosmetic. The skip is recorded; the artifact's other 5 chunks ARE indexed (so its content IS partially queryable). Closure could be tighter chunk sizing (3000 with 500 overlap) at bootstrap time, OR a per-chunk size guard that splits oversized chunks further before embedding. Not a structural defect in W1; not a blocker for D8 closure gates. Track for visibility.
carry_forwards_added.target: 0.3.2 (alongside the audit-machinery cluster; nomic-embed chunk-size handling is a peer to F-0.2.17-W6-001 retrieval-quality work) OR W2 if chunking refinement is in scope for W2 (drafter to decide)
carry_forwards_added.source: 0.3.1 W1 D2 bootstrap run (acceptance/W1.json deliverables[D2].evidence; bootstrap result.skipped_paths)
